related.description: Mockoon is the easiest and quickest way to run mock APIs locally. No remote deployment, no account required, open source.
In-page HTTP controller for frontend development. Intercept, modify, and simulate API responses directly in the browser.
Mock an API and generate fake JSON test data, right from the terminal.
High-performance, multi-protocol mock server. HTTP, WebSocket, gRPC, MQTT, SSE, GraphQL, SOAP in one binary.
The better way to deal with JSON data in Swift.
